verdict.rationale: Brevo documents API-key and OAuth 2.0 (including M2M) authentication, plus IP whitelisting, but nothing in the evidence shows credentials that can be limited to specific permissions, scopes or resources for an agent. Generic authentication and IP allowlisting are adjacent controls, not least-privilege credential scoping, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
